scope: Duke Strategies image library — 113 clean base images across 3 themes (bridges-span 46, bridge-structure 37, material-macro 30); boards 00–03, 2026-09-07.
allocationRule: Bridges open and close (cover/closing heroes, steel-vignette); material macro is background/divider stock (steel-flat, monotone, low contrast). Decision: operator, 2026-09-07 (board 03: keep all 113).
treatmentContract: Clean base images — house looks apply DOWNSTREAM from charter.expression.treatments (steel-vignette for cover/closing, steel-flat default). Never bake a look into these files.
overlayContract: overlayPolicy dark-NN = #222222 at NN% opacity over the image (charter v1.1 — overlays are structural dark, never coral). Tuned per image from measured luminance.
geometryNote: focalPoint = edge-energy centroid, textSafeZone = quietest horizontal third (tools/build_library.py heuristics; edit by hand to override).
